subject: Coverage horizon reconciliation and commit confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@skylark.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 coverage check — request for reconciliation

Hi Ben / Marcus / Naomi,

We're finalizing our internal procurement timeline and need a clean reconciliation of the pipeline against our committed budget for Q4. Can you confirm the current committed opportunities and what counts toward the 60% coverage target for our renewal window?

I've attached the pipeline extract we pulled from our side. Key asks from Skylark:
- Confirm which opportunities have legal/PO progress (DocuSign link or signed SOW).
- Confirm any stage changes you expect this week that will alter coverage.
- Provide an updated coverage number (pipe-to-quota) and any recommended actions if there's a shortfall.

We're on a hard procurement deadline the week of Dec 14 — anything you can lock sooner helps.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Skylark Analytics
(elena@skylark.io)

Attachment: skylark_pipeline_export_20261201.csv (CSV, 28k rows trimmed)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@skylark.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage check — request for reconciliation

Elena — thanks for the extract and the clear asks.

Quick plan: Marcus and I will reconcile stage flags and attach our snapshot. Naomi, can you confirm whether finance needs a separate SOW scan or if signed DocuSign artifacts are sufficient?

I've attached the snapshot we use for pipeline-to-quota. At a glance: total pipeline touching Skylark (open + commit-eligible) sits at $3.1M, target coverage (60%) = $1.86M. Current committed/contracted value visible to me is $1.3M — gap of ~$560k to the coverage target.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus: flag any opportunities you expect to close this week and mark whether legal/PO are in-flight.
- Naomi: confirm if finance will accept conditional commit (LOE + signed PO) or strictly executed SOWs.
- Elena: if Skylark has a PO window, indicate the earliest date we can show revenue recognition.

I'll hold a 30-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT if that works for everyone.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: skylark_pipeline_snapshot_20261201.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@skylark.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 coverage check — request for reconciliation

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 4:00 PM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the extract and the clear asks.
> 
> Quick plan: Marcus and I will reconcile stage flags and attach our snapshot. Naomi, can you confirm whether finance needs a separate SOW scan or if signed DocuSign artifacts are sufficient?

Notes from my reconciliation pass (inline):
- RDW-5781 (Skylark - Data Platform): move from "Proposal" -> "Commit". Legal has a DocuSign in flight (DocuSign ID: 3a2b8f). Expect executed SOW by 2026-12-06. Value: $450,000 (count toward committed if executed before 12/14). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5781
- RDW-5822 (Skylark - Observability): stays in "Late Stage". PO pending, customer has sign-off but procurement is waiting on internal budget release. Value: $225,000 (probability 65%). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5822
- RDW-5904 (Skylark - ML Ops Proof): push to next quarter — remove from Q4 coverage. Value: $120,000 (drop from coverage).

Attached the mutual action plan (MAP) with timeline annotations. If Elena can confirm PO window for RDW-5822, we can materially close the coverage gap.

Marcus Lin
Director, Midmarket Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Skylark_MAP_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@skylark.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Coverage horizon reconciliation and commit confirmation

Elena — looping back with a concise reconciliation and asks so procurement can proceed.

Reconciliation summary (as of 2026-12-02 09:00 PT):
- Coverage target (60% of Q4 quota): $1,860,000
- Committed / executed (SOW or executed DocuSign): $1,320,000
- Near-term upsides (DocuSign in-flight + high-prob PO): $450,000 (RDW-5781 expected executed by 2026-12-06) + $225,000 (RDW-5822 high-prob) = $675,000
- Adjusted potential committed if in-flight items execute before 12/14: $1,995,000 (meets coverage target)
- Known dropouts / pushed deals: RDW-5904 ($120,000) removed from Q4

Actions for Skylark: please confirm the PO/PO-window for RDW-5822 and, if possible, prioritize the DocuSign execution for RDW-5781. If both items clear before Dec 14 we meet the coverage target and can proceed with provisioning timelines.

Finance note (Naomi): if you prefer, I can provide a cleansed CSV with only committed/executed artifacts and dates for your ledger team — say yes and I'll send by EOD.

Elena — are you available for the 9:30am PT sync today? If not, propose a 15-min call this afternoon.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
